title: Adaptation and evaluation of an mHealth tool to improve knowledge on dementia prevention and support behavior change to reduce dementia risk (“MyBraincoach.de”) in middle-aged and older adults in Germany
summary:
MyBrainCoach is a mobile app designed to improve knowledge of dementia risk- and protective factors and to motivate users to adopt health-promoting behavior changes through personalized notifications. The app was originally developed at the Alzheimer Center Limburg and Maastricht University in the Netherlands. In this project, it is being translated into German and adapted to the German healthcare context.
In a three-month pilot study, 75 individuals aged 40 to 75 years will test the app. A qualitative evaluation with a subsample of eight participants will complement the study. The aim is to assess practicability of recruitment, as well as the app’s usability and perceived benefits/ usefulness, and to examine changes in users’ knowledge of dementia risk factors.
conditions: Healthy ageing, health promotion and prevention

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
signed consent form (online); sufficient knowledge of German; ownership of a smartphone; internet access; ability to download the app from the German Apple App Store or Google Play Store
Exclusion criteria:
no signed consent form; insufficient knowledge of German; no ownership of a smartphone; no internet access; serious illness that could jeopardize safe participation in the study; previous diagnosis of dementia; ongoing participation in other intervention studies on healthy ageing
